messages.author: edd4914c326b6d31
messages.subject: rstan development: traceplot inc_warmup ineffective
parts:
Using the development code
traceplot(myfit, pars="sigma_beta[2]", inc_warmup=FALSE)
prints a graph that says "does not include warmup" on the bottom, but it
does print the warmup and scale the graph to include the initial, wild,
values.

parts:
There was a change on Sep 19, 2013.  You should be able to see what version you are from the message printed out during loading rstan.  For example, the up-to-date one might be like the following.  And you can use rstan:::git_head() function to see the whole SHA, which can be compared with the commit history of github repo. 


> library(rstan)
Loading required package: Rcpp
Loading required package: inline

Attaching package: ‘inline’

The following object is masked from ‘package:Rcpp’:

    registerPlugin

Loading required package: stats4
rstan (Version 1.3.0, packaged: 2013-10-06 01:34:12 UTC, GitRev: e653ac31647e)
> rstan:::git_head()
[1] "e653ac31647e0b0ee800f0b60fec07ede96d26f9"

--
Jiqiang
